description.narrative: Gencau Sao Paulo Indústria e Comércio de Ingrediente Alimentícios Ltda. (Gencau or the Company) is a family-owned cocoa processing company which focuses on supplying traceable, sustainable, and high-quality cocoa products. Gencau is headquartered in Brazil with operations in the states of Pará, Bahia and Sao Paulo. IFCs proposed investment will support Gencaus growth in sustainable cocoa sourcing and processing (the Project).

IFC expects the Project to generate positive climate mitigation effects by promoting agroforestry in the supply chain and provide access to market and technical assistance for farmer suppliers. At the market level, IFC expects the Project to increase the competitiveness of Brazils cocoa processing industry by supporting an innovative player focused on sustainability.
